title: •Mandalorian Mishap
caption: •Mandalorian Mishap (V)
game_text: Suspend all Effects with “gangster” in game text for remainder of turn. OR Target a bounty hunter and/or gangster at a site. For remainder of turn, targets may not fire weapons and their game text is canceled.
lore: Most space-faring adventurers meet their fate with a calm, quiet dignity.
